shape: simple sequential (two pipeline registers, asynchronous reset on the second only)

generated_by.command: python -m benchmarks.run_chipverilog --task or1200_gmultp2_32x32 --effort xhigh --small-model gpt-5-mini --small-effort low --full-strength-stages refmodel

reference_model.mutant: python -m benchmarks.mutate <golden> <out> --op 0 -> line 44: * becomes + (p0 <= #1 xi * yi)
reference_model.verdict: correct on golden and discriminating against a wrong DUT
reference_model.note: An earlier reading of 36/36 against BOTH DUTs -- separation 0 -- was an equivalent mutant, not a vacuous model. mutate.py was picking a site inside `input [`OR1200_W-1:0] X`, which only widens the port; `xi` is an integer so `xi <= X` truncates back, and the harness drives only the 32-bit contract port. See the mutate.py commit.

rtl.note: This design ships no testbench, so it is scored by the equivalence flow and never reaches iverilog -- which is why its `input logic` ports cost it nothing, unlike alu's.
